verdict.rationale: 2FAS is an authenticator and password manager. User-configurable autonomous background automations are a plausible axis for this kind of product, but the evidence shows no such capability. Encrypted cloud sync and autofill are adjacent features rather than user-defined automations, and the live llms.txt probe states 'Public API: None', so there is no agent-callable surface to drive automations either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
